subject.title: Renderer placeholder leak: `(see attached image)`, `Image reply`, `Audio reply`, `Media reply` leak to human-visible Telegram reply under specific content-classification paths

question: Must a current-main Telegram payload trace demonstrate the placeholder crossing before work starts, or is the released-version report sufficient to authorize a shared reply-pipeline fix now?
rationale: The symptom is credible and the implicated machinery exists, but changing placeholder ownership without identifying the exact display boundary could damage prompt or transcript semantics.

options.title: Require the payload trace
options.body: Capture the resolved reply parts and redacted Telegram request for a media-only reply with a reply directive before authorizing implementation.

options.title: Authorize a guarded fix now
options.body: Allow a narrowly tested separation of prompt-only placeholders from display text based on the released-version reproduction and source analysis.

recommendation.title: Require the payload trace
recommendation.body: Capture the resolved reply parts and redacted Telegram request for a media-only reply with a reply directive before authorizing implementation.

likelyOwner.reason: The strongest available routing signal is recent ownership of Telegram rich-delivery behavior with live client validation.
